purpose: Revised guest AI and optional account screen concepts

prompts.free_ai_reading: Use case: ui-mockup. Design a genuinely distinctive Leximory native iPhone reading experience, 390 x 844 logical points portrait, app content only no phone bezel, status bar, notch, clock or home indicator. This replaces an overly generic account-gated concept. Product idea: user is already reading their own ebook and receives real contextual AI without signup. Make it intimate and literary using the actual Leximory aesthetic: white reading paper, EB Garamond content title, Libre Baskerville English prose, original Chinese Song serif body, black ink #434943 and a soft sage #BDD981 marker highlight at 45% opacity. Native controls with semantic neutral colors. NO signup buttons, marketing slogan, dashboard, rounded card inventory or big full-screen hero. Main source passage title near top 'The river path', fine newspaper rule beneath it. English prose at comfortable 18-20pt with generous line height: 'By late afternoon, the light had softened. We followed the narrow path along the bank, where the reeds leaned toward the water.' Highlight only the word 'bank' softly in sage. Place a compact beautiful paper definition bubble close to the selected word, not a giant bottom sheet; precisely aligned small pointer to the highlighted word. The bubble should be only about 230pt tall and contain the strong serif headword 'bank', tiny label '释义', Chinese definition '此处指河岸，即河流两侧高于水面的陆地。', and brief contextual line '这里不是“银行”的意思。'. A fine hairline separates the lower action row, which MUST remain below the definition. Use a compact native black book/bookmark icon button with '收藏词汇' and a quiet text link '词典'. This save is local, no account needed. Under action row one quiet 12-13pt line '今日还可免费查词 4 次', no progress meter, points currency, badge or upsell. Show more English prose below, 'Across the water, a small white house caught the last of the sun.' Keep original reading content visually continuous through bottom safe area. Bottom floating glass browser bar with a small book icon and label 'The river path', small back chevron to left, Home icon and More ellipsis to right. Avoid opaque footer, huge blank space, ornamental frame, device graphics, fake illustration. Attached actual Leximory lawn image is visual grounding for restraint and sage identity only; do NOT insert a lawn behind the prose. The distinctive quality must come from typography, exact anchored annotation, optical spacing, and the feeling of reading an actual book. Current date November 1 2026, no dates shown. This is a high fidelity design concept.
prompts.optional_account: Use case: ui-mockup. Design a distinctive optional Leximory account sign-in native large sheet, 390 x 844 logical points portrait app content only, no phone body bezel, status bar, notch, clock or home indicator. This is NOT a generic SaaS auth page. It appears only after a reader has already read freely, used contextual AI, collected the word bank locally, then explicitly chosen to keep their words in an account. Existing Leximory visual system: semantic white iOS sheet, neutral ink and native small close x at top-right, thin gray grabber, fixed Chinese display headings in elegant 欣意吉祥宋 Song serif, ordinary Chinese in original ChillDuanHeiSong Song serif, Latin EB Garamond for bookish content and Urbanist for interface. At top around y80 a discreet editorial eyebrow '已收藏在本机'. Below it at y110 an oversized beautiful EB Garamond italic word 'bank' around 48pt, pale sage marker stroke behind only the word, with tiny Chinese translation '河岸' aligned to its baseline. Below a short prose excerpt at 17pt in true Libre Baskerville italic, 'We followed the narrow path along the bank.' With fine vertical hairline at left and small source title 'The river path' under. This excerpt is authentic context, NOT a card. Then generous spacing, left-aligned Chinese heading '带上你遇见的词' around 26pt and supporting copy '登录后，将本机收藏的词汇存入账号。'. Keep text primary/secondary neutral. Then FLAT native form rows with fine separator, persistent 邮箱 and 密码 labels, email placeholder 'yourname@example.com', secure dots, no giant rounded input card, no field icons. Neutral link '忘记密码？'. Full-width black 52pt capsule '登录并保存'. Small centered secondary '没有账号？ 注册' and 13pt footer links '服务条款 与 隐私政策'. Integrate a SMALL original watercolor lawn with a single white cat at the sheet's very bottom, low contrast, roughly 65pt tall, softly irregular paper edge, preserve the reference art style, no invented cartoon mascot, no giant illustration behind the form. Reference lawn image is the ACTUAL Leximory art; second reference is the cat sprite sheet, choose one calm standing pose, never show a sprite grid. The scenery is a quiet brand signature after the useful form, not a hero. The user can dismiss freely; no forced consent toggle, progress stepper, quota upsell, marketing benefits list, or social login buttons. Follow native safe areas and readable touch targets. DESIGN CONCEPT not actual screenshot. Current date November 1 2026, no visible dates.
prompts.allowance_state: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a thoughtfully designed Leximory iPhone ebook reading screen with a graceful free AI allowance exhausted state, 390 x 844 logical points portrait, app content only, no phone bezel, device shadow, status bar, notch, clock or home indicator. User has been reading freely without signup. This is a calm intentional reading state, not an error screen or conversion funnel. Existing Leximory literary design language: white reading paper continuous to bottom, EB Garamond book title, Libre Baskerville English body text at 18-20pt with comfortable line spacing; ordinary Chinese ChillDuanHeiSong Song serif, fixed Chinese display labels elegant 欣意吉祥宋. Near top content title 'The river path', newspaper hairline and enough English prose to feel like a real page: 'By late afternoon, the light had softened. We followed the narrow path along the bank, where the reeds leaned toward the water.' Soft sage #BDD981 at 45% opacity highlights ONLY the currently selected word 'reeds'. Near this selection show a balanced, content-sized paper lookup bubble, white native surface with subtle paper border and a small pointer anchored exactly to 'reeds'. Strong headword 'reeds'. Below it text '今天的免费查词已用完。' at 17pt and secondary '明天可以继续，已收藏的词仍可查看。' at 15pt. Preserve proper whitespace, no exclamation icon, red, lock, sad cat, countdown, quota progress bar or opaque full-width banner. A fine rule above the bubble's action row below all copy. Two neutral native actions: '登录，使用账号额度' and quieter '词典'. Do NOT use '升级', '立即注册', payment price, premium, free trial label, or a giant black conversion button. This optional login may use existing account quota; the normal reader remains fully usable if the user dismisses the bubble. An existing previously saved bank annotation may have a subtle underline in the prose, but do NOT show its definition under the newly selected word. More English prose continues below: 'Across the water, a small white house caught the last of the sun.' At bottom existing compact translucent browser bar with book symbol and 'The river path', back chevron, Home and More, all neutral. Preserve beautiful optical spacing and editorial precision. Attached actual Leximory lawn art is visual grounding for sage color and delicacy only; no lawn illustration added to this reading screen. Current date November 1 2026, no visible dates. DESIGN CONCEPT not screenshot.
prompts.allowance_correction: Edit this Leximory allowance-exhausted reading design with one correction: remove the small letter-spaced LEXIMORY wordmark at the top and remove its thin horizontal rule. Leave that small top region as the same clean white page background. Keep the book title The river path, every paragraph, selected reeds highlight, definition bubble, all Chinese copy, action buttons and bottom browser bar exactly as they are. Do not add a replacement logo or illustration. Preserve all geometry below the deleted wordmark. Native reading content should not have a redundant app masthead.

limitations: Raster studies do not establish exact bundled font rendering or native behavior.
Definition bubbles must overlay existing reader content without reflow.
Implement the existing native browser bar and popovers rather than tracing generated geometry.
Production dimensions, dark appearance, accessibility and keyboard layout require native verification.
